sheet:
Create an original game-production pixel-art character asset sheet, transparent background, high resolution 1536 by 1536 square, strict 4 columns by 3 rows of equally sized invisible cells, generous transparent gutters, no text no labels no grid no ground shadows. Use the supplied reference ONLY for the illustrated pixel style and compact humanoid proportions, NOT copying the lineup layout. Warm refined Japanese chibi pixel illustration with clean crisp pixel edges, cohesive warm upper-left lighting, restrained medium pixel clusters, softly rounded features, large expressive brown eyes, little nose, tousled short chestnut hair with a small swept lock. New original youthful adult adventurer "Maple": rich terracotta orange crew-neck long-sleeve knitted sweater with cream ribbed collar/cuffs/hem, muted dark teal straight trousers, chestnut leather ankle boots with thick soles. Pale warm peach skin. 3/4 front view facing viewer RIGHT. Head large about 42% height, body/legs about58%, compact V6 proportions. No bag, scarf, jewelry, hat, props or embroidery. Sweater simple readable fabric folds with subtle knit accents, no dense random texture.

This is a technical production breakdown sheet of ONE consistent character; paint every part including normally hidden areas in the same style. Each isolated body part fully separated, no foreign cloth/hair/skin fragments.
ROW1 CELL1: complete full-body character in neutral relaxed standing pose facing right, arms slightly away from torso, boots both on same ground baseline. CELL2: detached complete neutral head with short exposed neck, ears and all hair, no shoulders no clothes. CELL3: exact same head angle, silhouette and short neck with gentle warm smile, softened brows and smiling eyes still OPEN. CELL4: exact same head with joyful closed crescent eyelids and natural happy open mouth, rosy cheeks. Keep all three head silhouettes identical.
ROW2 CELL1: detached COMPLETE sweater torso, right3/4 view, no head, no arms no hands no legs. Short peach neck stump inside cream round collar, shoulders fully painted behind arm sockets, full side panels down to cream ribbed waist hem. CELL2: isolated NEAR whole arm, long orange sleeve from rounded shoulder cap through nearly straight elbow to cream cuff and complete relaxed peach hand, vertical pointing down, subtle outward slant. Paint closed rounded shoulder cap for articulation. NO torso, waistband or other parts. CELL3: isolated FAR whole arm same garment but narrower, slightly darker, pointing down, complete closed shoulder cap and cuff/hand, no other parts. CELL4: separate dark teal trousers HIP/PELVIS piece only, from waistband through crotch, complete hidden side panels and rounded thigh openings, no sweater hem attached.
ROW3 CELL1: isolated NEAR whole trouser leg from rounded upper thigh through knee to hem at ankle, nearly straight slight outward slant, no foot and no boot, consistent full pants width and covered knee. CELL2: isolated FAR whole trouser leg, narrower with same dark teal cloth, from thigh through knee down to ankle, no foot no boot. CELL3: isolated NEAR ankle boot, toe points right, complete ankle opening/shaft fully painted, thick leather sole, no trousers or skin attached. CELL4: isolated FAR matching ankle boot, toe points right, complete ankle shaft, slightly narrower/darker.
Make parts substantial within their own cells, avoid clipping or any connected pieces across gutters. Reference cell1 fullbody is design truth. This sheet will be mechanically cut and registered to an existing skeleton later, so clean silhouettes and full hidden joint coverage are essential. Preserve transparent alpha everywhere outside painted objects.
torsoDraft: Using the attached original Maple character asset sheet, draw ONE corrected game rigging sweater TORSO BACKPLATE ONLY, transparent background, with the same orange knit fabric, cream ribbed crew-neck collar and cream waist hem. This is a hidden base piece for 2D skeletal animation. NO arms, NO sleeves, NO cuffs, NO hands, NO head, NO hair, NO skin neck stump, NO pants. Only the main sweater BODY from the collar around both shoulders through chest/waist to the ribbed hem. Retain the exact original chest right-facing3/4 perspective and orange/cream colors. The left and right outline must run smoothly from small rounded shoulder tops at collar-height directly down the side seams to the waist hem, narrowest at the waist. The detached arms from the source sheet will cover these side seams later. Keep the fabric complete behind both arm sockets, without transparent holes or black cut-edge stripes. Crewneck opening can show dark warm interior but no peach skin; the complete head/neck asset will sit on top. Sweater short compact chibi proportions, broad across shoulders, body about as wide as tall. Cozy hand-painted pixel illustration with clear restrained pixel clusters, warm upper-left lighting, thin brown outlines, subtle knit detail, no new pattern. Center just this torso with generous transparent margin. Do not redraw the whole sheet and do not include limbs.
torsoFinal: Edit this orange knit torso into a COMPLETELY SLEEVELESS SWEATER VEST technical sprite. Remove the entire large folded sleeve/arm shape on the LEFT and the small sleeve shape on the RIGHT. There must be NO tube or hanging cuff on either side. The remaining vest body is an uninterrupted single panel of orange knit from armpit to waistband. Narrow smooth inward sloping sides from shoulder to waist, rounded shoulders at the top, same cream ribbed crewneck and same cream waist hem. Keep the chest subtle folds, upper-left warm light, rich terracotta color, right three-quarter perspective, crisp illustrated pixel style and generous transparent background. This is the underlying body of a separated puppet sweater: sleeves are separate images and will cover shoulders. Only draw a compact sleeveless sweater VEST with full continuous side coverage; no head, neck skin, arms, hands, pants, accessories or text. Especially eliminate the sleeve's deep dark curved vertical seam on the left: fill this with continuous main-body orange fabric.
